ValidationRule.description: Weekend start dates are only allowed for Critical projects or on Jan 1, and never in Dec/Jan unless that exemption holds.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), OR(WEEKDAY(Start_Date__c) = 1, WEEKDAY(Start_Date__c) = 7), NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(Priority__c, 'Critical'), DAYOFYEAR(Start_Date__c) = 1)), CASE(MONTH(Start_Date__c), 12, 0, 1, 0, 1) = 1 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Start Date falls on a weekend without an exemption.
